topics.topic: Mkpụrụedemede Igbo (Abidii Igbo): Ụdaume (8) na Mgbochiume (28)
learningObjectives: Ịmata mkpụrụedemede iri atọ na isii (36) dị n'Abidii Igbo
Ịkọwa ụdaume asatọ (a, e, i, ị, o, ọ, u, ụ)
Ịkọwapụta mgbochiume iri abụọ na asatọ (28) na ịkpọ ha n'ụzọ ziri ezi

topics.topic: Udaume na Mgbochiume: Ụdaume mfe na ụdaume arọ
learningObjectives: Ịmata ọdịiche dị n'etiti ụdaume mfe (a, e, o, u) na ụdaume arọ (ị, ọ, ụ)
Ịkọwa iwu ndakorita udaume n'asụsụ Igbo
Ide mkpụrụokwu dị iche iche na-egosipụta ụdaume ndị a

topics.topic: Akara Ụdaolu na Igbo: Ụdaelu, ụdandarị, na ụdaala na mmetụta ha na nkọwa okwu
learningObjectives: Ịmata akara ụdaolu atọ: ụdaelu (/), ụdaala (\), na ụdandarị (-)
Ịtụnye akara ụdaolu kwesịrị ekwesị n'elu mkpụrụokwu
Ịkọwa etu akara ụdaolu si agbanwe nkọwa okwu (dịka: akwa, akwà, àkwà)

topics.topic: Nkejiasụsụ Igbo: Ụdị mkpọaha na ojiji ha
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa ihe bụ mkpọaha n'asụsụ Igbo
Ịmata ụdị mkpọaha dị iche iche (aha mmadụ, aha anụmanụ, aha ihe, aha obodo)
Iji mkpọaha mepụta ahịrịokwu ziri ezi

topics.topic: Ekele na Nsọpụrụ n'Ala Igbo: Ụzọ dị iche iche e si ekene n'ụtụtụ, ehihie, na anyasị
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa mkpa ekele dị n'omenala ndị Igbo
Ịkọwapụta ekele ụtụtụ (Ị bọọla chi?), ehihie (Ndewo), na anyasị (Ka chi boo)
Igosipụta nsọpụrụ n'ebe ndị okenye na ndị nne na nna nọ n'ala Igbo

topics.topic: Edemede Nkọwa: "Ụlọakwụkwọ m" ma ọ bụ "Ahịa Obodo Anyị"
learningObjectives: Ịmata usoro nchikota edemede: mbido, isi edemede, na nkwubiokwu
Iji mkpụrụokwu ziri ezi na akara edemede de edemede nkọwa
Ide edemede mara mma banyere ụlọakwụkwọ ha n'asụsụ Igbo

topics.topic: Nlele Nnwale Nke Etiti Oge na Nchikota Akara
learningObjectives: Inyocha nghọta ụmụakwụkwọ na mkpụrụedemede na akara ụdaolu
Idozi nsogbu dị na nsụpe okwu na edemede
Inye ndụmọdụ maka nkwalite ọmụmụ asụsụ Igbo

topics.topic: Agụmagụ Ọdịnala: Akụkọ ifo, abụ ọdịnala, na ilu Igbo
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa ihe bụ agụmagụ ọdịnala na ngalaba ya
Ịkọ akụkọ ifo ndị nwere mbe na anụmanụ ndị ọzọ
Ịmata nkuzi dị mma na ịdọ aka ná ntị dị n'akụkọ ifo ndị ahụ

topics.topic: Omenaala na Ewumewu: Alụmdi na nwunye, ọmụmụ nwa, na ichi ọchịchị n'ala Igbo
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa usoro nleba anya na nkwado n'alụmdi na nwunye n'ala Igbo
Ịmata emume iku nwa n'ala na igba igu aha
Ịkọwa ọkwa ndị okenye na ndị nze na ọzọ n'obodo

topics.topic: Ilu na Akpaalaokwu Igbo: Nkọwa na otu e si eji ha na nkwurịta okwu
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa na ilu bụ mmanụ e ji eri okwu n'ala Igbo
Ịkọwa ihe ilu ndị ama ama pụtara na oge e kwesịrị iji ha
Iji akpaalaokwu mee ka nkwurịta okwu dị mma ma mikpuo emikpu

topics.topic: Nka na Ọrụ aka ndị Igbo: Ịkpu ite, ịkpụ ụzụ, na ịkwa akwa
learningObjectives: Ịkpọpụta ọrụ aka ndị nna nna anyị na-arụ n'ala Igbo
Ịkọwa etu e si akpụ ụzụ na mkpa ọrụ ụzụ dị n'ugbo na nchekwa
Ịkọwapụta ngwa e ji arụ ọrụ aka ndị a dị iche iche

topics.topic: Nchịkọta na Nlegharị Anya maka Ule Ọgwụgwụ Oge
learningObjectives: Inyocha isiokwu niile a kụziri na tọm a n'asụsụ, omenaala na agụmagụ
Idozi ajụjụ nlereanya maka nkwado ule
Ịgba ụmụakwụkwọ ume ka ha nwee ntụkwasị obi n'asụsụ nne ha

topics.topic: Ule Ọgwụgwụ Oge na Ndekọ Akara Broadsheet
learningObjectives: Inye ụmụakwụkwọ ule nke ederede na nke ọnụ n'asụsụ Igbo
Iji ụkpụrụ NERDC gbaa akara ule
Idebanye aha na akara ule na brodsheet nke ụlọakwụkwọ
